description.value: The La Taquería group operates three distinct Mexican concepts across Metro Vancouver, and 2450 Yukon St. is home to Comedor, their counter-service street-food outpost offering tacos, burritos, and specialties like Quesabirria and Birriamen. The casual, fast-service format makes it a practical stop for a touring cyclist looking for a filling, flavourful meal near the Cambie Street corridor. A broad menu with several plant-based options adds to its appeal for mixed groups.

No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
